{{Short description|German mathematician (1855–1915)}}
[[File:Johannes Knoblauch.jpg|thumb|right|{{center|Johannes Knoblauch}}]]
'''Johannes Knoblauch''' (27 August 1855, [[Halle (Saale)]] – 22 July 1915, [[Berlin]]) was a German mathematician.<ref>{{cite web|title=Biografie, Johannes Knoblauch|website=Wissenschaftliche Sammlungen, Humboldt Universität zu Berlin|url=http://www.sammlungen.hu-berlin.de/dokumente/15944/}}</ref>

==Biography==
Johannes Knoblauch, whose father was the physics professor [[Hermann Knoblauch|Karl Hermann Knoblauch]], studied law, mathematics and physics from 1872 in Halle, Heidelberg and Berlin. At the Friedrich Wilhelm University (later renamed the [[Humboldt University of Berlin]]) he studied from 1874 to 1878 and from 1880 to 1883 and received his [[Promotion (Germany)|''Promotion'']] (Ph.D.) in 1882 and his ''[[Habilitation]]'' in 1883.<ref name=NDB>{{NDB|12|194|195|Knoblauch, Johannes|Ingrid Ahrens|116257989}}</ref> His doctoral dissertation "Ueber die Allgemeine Wellenfläche" was supervised by [[Karl Weierstrass]].<ref>{{cite thesis|author=Knoblauch, Johannes|title=Ueber die allgemeine Wellenfläche|website=Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin|year=1882 |url=https://edoc.hu-berlin.de/handle/18452/843|doi=10.18452/191}}</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=9716|name=Johanness Knoblauch}}</ref> Knoblauch was a teacher for the academic year 1878–1879 at (his former school) the state [[Gymnasium (Germany)|''Gymnasium'']] in Halle and from 1879 to 1880 at Berlin's [[Evangelisches Gymnasium zum Grauen Kloster|''Gymnasium zum Grauen Kloster'']]. At the Friedrich Wilhelm University of Berlin, after his ''Habilitation'' in 1883 he was appointed [[Privatdozent]]. There in 1889 he was appointed professor extraordinarius and retained that academic post until his death.<ref name=NDB/> From 1883 to 1885 his friend Heinrich von Stein stayed with him in the ''Knoblauch-Haus'' at Poststrasse 23.<ref> Markus Bernauer: "Heinrich von Stein." Walter de Gruyter, 1998, {{ISBN|3-11-016181-8}}, pp. 65 & 204 ([https://books.google.com/books?id=TJ1IOunzDogC&pg=PA204 e-book])</ref> In 1906/07 Knoblauch worked with [[Kazimierz Żorawski]] on new [[Group theory|group theoretical]] methods.<ref>[[Karin Reich]]: "The development of the tensor calculus." Birkhäuser, 1994, {{ISBN|3-7643-2814-2}}, p. 104 ([https://books.google.com/books?id=O6lixBzbc0gC&pg=PA104 e-book])</ref>

Knoblauch was a founding member of the Berlin Mathematical Society. For 13 years he was a member of the editorial board of the ''[[Crelle's Journal]]''.

[[File:St.-Marien- und St.-Nicolai-Friedhof Pankow Okt. 2016 - 21.jpg|thumb|{{center|Gravesite}}]]
In 1884, he married Luise ''née'' Eyssenhardt (1865–1940).<ref name=NDB/> The grave of the married couple is in the cemetery ''Alter Friedhof der St.-Nikolai- und St.-Marien-Gemeinde'' in the [[Pankow]] [[Boroughs and neighborhoods of Berlin|borough of Berlin]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Grave of Johannes Knoblauch in Berlin-Friedrichshain|url=http://www.w-volk.de/museum/grave65.htm}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
* ''Theorie der algebraischen Curven und Flächen höherer Ordnung.'' 1885
* [https://books.google.com/books?id=Qk07AQAAIAAJ ''Einleitung in die allgemeine Theorie der krummen Flächen'']. 1888
* [https://archive.org/details/grundlagenderdi00knobgoog/page/n5/mode/2up  ''Grundlagen der Differentialgeometrie'']. 1913
* ''Ueber Biegungscovarianten.'' 1892. {{doi|10.1515/crll.1893.111.277}}
* ''Vorlesungen über die Theorie der Elliptischen Functionen''. 1913
* ''Die Biegungs-Invarianten und Kovarianten von gegebener Ordnung.'' 1906. {{doi|10.1515/crll.1906.131.247}}
* ''Ein Bildnis Leonhard Eulers in Privatbesitz.'' 1911
* ''Die Differentialgleichung der Flächen mit isometrischen Krümmungslinien.'' 1912
===As an editor===
* ''Mathematische Werke von Karl Weierstrass'', edited by Johannes Knoblauch, Georg Hettner, and Rudolf Rothe
** ''[http://name.umdl.umich.edu/AAN8481.0001.001 Abhandlungen-1]'', Math. Werke. vol. 1. Berlin, 1894
** ''[http://name.umdl.umich.edu/AAN8481.0002.001 Abhandlungen-2]'', Math. Werke. vol. 2. Berlin, 1895
** ''[http://name.umdl.umich.edu/AAN8481.0003.001 Abhandlungen-3]'', Math. Werke. vol. 3. Berlin, 1903
** ''[http://name.umdl.umich.edu/AAN8481.0004.001 Vorl. ueber die Theorie der Abelschen Transcendenten]'', Math. Werke. Bd. 4. Berlin, 1902
** ''[http://name.umdl.umich.edu/AAN8481.0007.001 Vorl. ueber Variationsrechnung]'', Math. Werke. vol. 7. Leipzig, 1927
